title: hemionitis deltoidea
intro: Hemionitis deltoidea, commonly known as the Indian Spikenard or Chota Chandana, is an evergreen plant species belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis deltoidea include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
